scope: All 948 named executions: the original 944 plus four mandatory held paced cases. Include every known issue not proved corrected by successful relevant testing, including failures and required coverage outside this named subtotal. Original-computer progress does not exempt destination executions.
completion_rule: Every task must obtain an actual new-host result for the pinned candidate. No missing, skipped, cancelled, setup-blocked, or queued execution counts as passed. Record typed approved warnings/omissions explicitly, never as assertion passes.
not_in_subtotal: Other applicable full-matrix frontend/web/native-GUI/platform/package/archive/copied-binary and complete calibration scopes remain required; the 948 named cases are not the complete workflow inventory.
Matched callback baseline/probe experiments are diagnostic measurements, not additional qualification passes.
A green local manifest is not by itself a GitHub Actions green check or public release certification.

variables.ctest: CTest from the selected profile; SDK uses its prepared SDK CTest
variables.build_dir: An already configured and built, shard-private tree of target_revision for this profile
variables.result_dir: A shard-private absolute result directory created before execution; no shared CTest output writers

preflight: Check immutable source, clean/retained dirty identities and actual available CPU/memory/storage.
Configure through ./build.sh and the existing pinned workflow/dependency recipe. Do not copy configured CMake trees between computers.

Collect current CTest show-only=json-v1. For every ctest task, its exact name and registration argv/properties must match the intended test path; record unmatched/missing registrations as setup-blocked, not skipped.
Honor PROCESSORS, RUN_SERIAL, locks, environment and timeouts. Preserve test command arguments such as --ci-functional-clock or calibration --workers/--section.
Execute each execution_group once; map its JUnit cases to all listed task_ids. In particular, the GUI parallel pair must run together with --parallel2.
This manifest grants no different model, repair allowance, package-maintenance scope, Git/publication permission or deadline waiver.

Reconcile source-bound results and unresolved_issues before execution. The original destination source pin is retained as provenance; distinguish it from the current diagnostic candidate and bind any approved successor explicitly. Preserve assignment identities, failures and existing repair limits.
evidence_per_result: exact tested commit/tree plus any dirty patch hashes
actual argv/environment relevant to test execution
stdout/stderr and JUnit or existing structured result, with hashes
expected/observed testcase count, every failure and every explicit omission/warning
PCM/progress/trace/physical-end evidence where required by the original fixture

For held cases: matched unheld PCM identity, generated versus captured/processed input, material holds or qualified drains, producer guard/abort cause and clean health; correct final bits cannot override invalid input.

parallel_policy.scheduling: Queue all948 immediately. Execute all independent ready profile/shard groups concurrently within available native agent slots and actual hardware limits. A failure in one group must not cancel unrelated ready groups. Build availability and indivisible timing groups are real dependencies.
parallel_policy.cheap_execution_role: luna_worker: gpt-6-luna/high for authorized bounded execution and settled independent work; use luna_scout for read-only evidence. Preserve primary model and Sol takeovers/independent acceptance.
parallel_policy.writes: Separate checkout/build/output per concurrently writing shard; one canonical integration/Git writer. Do not duplicate a group merely because it contains two task IDs.
parallel_policy.resource_rule: Do not equate agent slots with CPU slots. Protect timing-sensitive fixtures from unrelated CPU saturation. Hosted diagnostic runner ceiling5 remains; it is not a local scout-agent quota.
parallel_policy.ownership: instrumented-gui-core-failures-20261018 retains original consequential ownership; record original failed assignments/repairs across computers and do not restart allowances.

focus_gnu_debug.timing_rule: Preserve original serial and parallel GUI groups. Reserve suitable CPU headroom for deadline-sensitive groups; no competing heavy jobs in that timing allocation.

focus_gnu_debug.build_directory_rule: Each concurrently executing shard gets a separately configured build/output directory; serialize writes to any shared Git checkout.

unresolved_issues.title: observed producer-deadline failure and truncated input
unresolved_issues.evidence_and_required_closure_markdown:
- Failing case: `test_symbol_burst_live --paced-held-keyed-on` in run
  `39496135280`, job `118881553768`, source `72189bc`, exit 1.
- Exact failure: `paced diagnostic failed: paced producer stopped:
  deadline/callback failure; input truncated; cleanup: `.
- Maximum callback duration was **20,711,219 ns**; producer abort reason was 4,
  after the callback, against the unchanged 20 ms guard. The requested cadence
  was 16 samples every 1,953,125 ns. A positive-lateness counter is not a count
  of 20 ms violations.
- The fixture generated **223,296 samples**, FNV-1a `d34970be1abe7755`, but its
  final snapshot had only **216,304 captured**, **214,624 processed**, 1,664
  queued physical samples and 16 decoding samples. The correct complete
  16-bit row and eight observed gap drains do **not** make that capture valid.
- Cause remains unproved: capture CPU, descheduling, blocked waits including
  the Live mutex, mixed causes and an unaccounted remainder are being measured.
  A long callback envelope alone does not identify CPU work or lock contention.
  The current run adds bounded wall/thread-CPU/scheduling and snapshot markers,
  plus matched baseline/probe pairs; probe compilation, operation and overhead
  remain unverified until results arrive.
- Required closure: establish the responsible path or supported classification,
  complete the original functional case with valid full input, clean health,
  physical END, exact content and process closure, and satisfy the existing
  acceptance route. Preserve the original failed result. One non-reproducing
  diagnostic pair is not proof of a correction. No input-integrity or deadline
  waiver has been granted for this case.

unresolved_issues.title: latest integrated recurring backlog-rescue acceptance
unresolved_issues.evidence_and_required_closure_markdown:
- Successful earlier evidence is retained: source `e231e4d`, run `39490234022`,
  demonstrated **14 plaintext-On and 8 keyed-On** qualified post-startup drains
  with valid complete input. On `72189bc`, plaintext-On again passed 14 drains;
  keyed-Off passed 16 material control holds after its stimulus repair.
- The latest completed keyed-On case nevertheless failed Issue 9. Its eight
  drains cannot be counted as a passing whole case with truncated input.
- Require valid independently paced plaintext/keyed Off/On cases, matching
  held/unheld PCM identities, real queued PCM/age, complete original acquisition
  promises and guard union, at least three qualified post-startup On drains,
  exact source bits, earliest lineage and fully scored physical absence. Off
  controls make no rescue claim. A forced service-gap demonstration does not
  establish natural end-user hardware throughput.
- Keep the three-drain/material-hold assertions and all original producer,
  guard, source-tail and input-integrity checks. Do not solve the failure by
  omitting acquisition coverage, blocking the producer or manufacturing counters.
